fullDescription: SetSplit is a premium dark-mode production management dashboard designed for creative industries like filmmaking, agency work, and project tracking. It features a high-contrast color palette of deep charcoal (#121212) and vibrant gold-yellow (#ffd700). The UI utilizes the Plus Jakarta Sans typeface for a modern, legible, and professional feel. Key layout elements include a vertical list of detailed project cards with varying data visualizations (circular progress, linear progress bars, and avatar stacks) and a fixed bottom navigation bar with a signature floating action button (FAB). Ideal for SaaS dashboards, financial tracking, and creative project management apps.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-fidelity mobile dashboard design for production tracking, featuring a dark theme, yellow accent colors, and modular project cards with rich data visualization elements like progress rings and progress bars.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a background color of #121212. Use the font 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Primary accent color is #ffd700. Surfaces and cards should be #1a1a1a with 1px borders of #333333 and a corner radius of 16px (2xl). Typography: Headings in font-weight 700, sub-labels in weight 500-600 with font-sizes 10px-12px (text-xs/text-[10px]). Use a progress circle component with a 4px stroke using #333333 as base and #ffd700 as the progress indicator. Buttons and interactive cards must include a smooth 'active:scale-95' or 'active:bg-#222222' transition. Shadow for the primary FAB should be '0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3)'.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Positioned at the top with 'padding-top: 56px' and 'padding-horizontal: 24px'. Left side contains a user profile section: a 40px circular avatar with a 2px #ffd700 border and 2px inner padding, followed by a vertical stack of 'Bem-vindo' (12px, gray-400) and the User Name (16px, bold). Right side features a 40px square settings button with 12px rounded corners, #1a1a1a background, and a Lucide 'settings' icon.

### Section Header
An auto-layout row with 'margin-top: 24px' and 'margin-bottom: 16px'. Contains a section title 'PRODUÇÕES RECENTES' (14px, bold, gray-400, uppercase) and a 'Ver todas' link (12px, bold, #ffd700) on the opposite ends.

### Project Cards List
A vertical stack of cards with 16px (space-y-4) spacing. Each card is #1a1a1a with a 1px border. Card internal padding is 16px. Content includes: Top row with a status badge (10px, bold, uppercase, low-opacity background) and a context icon. Middle row with a Large Title (18px, bold). Bottom row (often separated by a light border-t) containing metrics like budget/balance or progress bars.

### Bottom Navigation
A fixed footer with a 'glass-nav' style: #1a1a1a background with a 1px top border of #333333. Height of 64px with extra bottom padding for safe areas (34px). Five slots: 4 icon-only links (24px icons) in gray-500, and a central elevated button. The central button is a 56px circle, color #ffd700, shifted upwards by 32px (relative top-[-8]) with a signature glow shadow.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Circular Progress Ring — A compact data visualization showing percentage completion.
Construct a 48px diameter circle. Use a 4px stroke width. The track color is #333333. The progress stroke is #ffd700. Center the text (e.g., '38%') using 10px bold font weight in #ffd700. The progress stroke should use a rounded cap or clean cutoff depending on the percentage.

### Status Badge — Small categorized labels for project status.
Height: 20px approx (padding: 2px 8px). Background: 10% opacity of the text color. Text: 10px, font-weight: 700, uppercase. Border-radius: 4px. Example: Green badge uses text #4ade80 with background rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.1).

### Avatar Stack — Overlapping avatars to show team participation.
A series of 24px circular avatars with a negative horizontal space of -8px. Each avatar must have a 1px border matching the card background (#1a1a1a) to create a 'cutout' effect. The final circle in the stack can be a counter (e.g., +5) with a gray-500 background and 8px bold text.

## Notas Especiais
Must hide the default browser scrollbar for the main content area. Ensure all badges have a 10% opacity version of their text color as their background color. The 'active' state on cards must be subtle (#222222). Circular progress must always use #ffd700 for the 'top' or 'active' stroke.

style.description: The style is 'Modern Dark Premium' characterized by deep backgrounds, subtle borders, and high-contrast accents. It uses Plus Jakarta Sans for all typography with weights ranging from 400 to 700. The color palette is centered around #121212 (Background), #1a1a1a (Cards/Surfaces), #333333 (Borders), and #ffd700 (Primary Accent). Secondary status colors include Blue-400, Green-400, and Purple-400 for categorization. Interactive elements feature micro-interactions like scale-down transitions (active:scale-95) and glassmorphism-inspired navigation layers.
